profile_text.body:
Pony AI Inc. is an autonomous driving technology company. On its own site it describes itself as pursuing a vision of autonomous mobility and says it develops autonomous driving technology for Robotaxi, Robotruck, and Personally Owned Vehicle (POV) business units. It calls its core technology a "virtual driver" and says it has secured licenses and credentials to test and operate autonomous driving vehicles in multiple locations worldwide. The company states it was founded in 2016 in Silicon Valley and describes itself as a global leader in autonomous mobility and a pioneer in extending those technologies and services.

The site reports that Pony.ai's autonomous vehicles had traveled over 32 million kilometers (over 13 million miles) on urban roads and highways as of April 2024, and that the company has accumulated millions of kilometers of autonomous road testing in complex scenarios. It says its vehicles have operated in difficult weather and road conditions, which it presents as groundwork for scalable autonomous driving products and services.

Company records list Pony AI Inc. as a for-profit public company with headquarters in Guangzhou and the ticker PONY. No lawsuits, no tracked products, and no MCP servers are recorded for it.
